sloka: तथापि त्वां मया युक्तः सायको ऽस्त्रप्रयोजितः ।जीवतं परिरक्षन्तं जीविताद् भ्रंशयिष्यति ।। ६.५९.८८ ।।।।
transliteration: tathāpi tvāṁ mayā yuktaḥ sāyako 'straprayojitaḥ ।jīvataṁ parirakṣantaṁ jīvitād bhraṁśayiṣyati ।। 6.59.88 ।।।।

translations.english: "Oh monkey! You are taking different forms and doing different deeds. If you have the ability, save your life."
